title: SweetCookie conformance case
description: spec/conformance/<domain>/<case>/case.yaml. Describes one executable statement of the form 'given this add-on, this must happen'. See spec/conformance/README.md.

id.description: Must equal <domain>/<case>, matching the directory path.

tier.description: T0 parse only, no Minecraft. T1 translation to runtime objects, no world. T2 headless server behaviour. T3 rendering, needs a client. T4 manual, needs a human. Choose the LOWEST tier that can prove the claim.

features.description: Bedrock feature IDs this case proves. Each must exist in a coverage shard; specConformance checks the link in both directions.

description.description: What divergence or behaviour this case pins down, in one or two sentences. Say what would break if it regressed.

pack.description: The add-on under test. 100% ORIGINAL CONTENT — constitution rule 10. Either a directory of files or a fixture to extend.

dir.description: Directory relative to the case, containing a pack tree. Defaults to 'pack'.

container.description: How the tree is presented to the loader. 'directory' hands it over unpacked; the others zip it first, so that a case claiming to prove a container feature actually exercises that container rather than a directory that looks like one.

extends.description: A fixture under spec/conformance/_fixtures/ to layer this pack on top of.

loadOrder.description: For multi-pack cases: explicit pack order, overriding SC-100 section 5.

steps.description: Actions performed before assertions. Executed in order. T2+ only.

expect.description: Golden files this case compares against, relative to the case directory. Goldens are canonical JSON (SC-000 section 6) except images.

screenshotTolerance.description: Permitted mean per-channel difference, 0-255. Rendering is not bit-exact across drivers.

assert.description: Inline assertions for things too small to justify a golden file.

notContains.description: The mirror of 'contains', and the mirror of the 'forbidden' diagnostic list. Something that must NOT appear is the class of regression that otherwise goes unnoticed for months.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostic codes this case must produce, and codes it must NOT produce. A case that silently starts warning is a regression.

exhaustive.description: When true, any diagnostic not in 'expected' fails the case.

versions.description: Minecraft nodes this case runs on. Omit for all. Use ONLY for cases about a version-specific mechanism — behaviour must not differ by version (SC-220 section 5).

loaders.description: Loaders this case runs on. Omit for all.

via.description: Version-translation equivalence, SC-270 section 13. Runs the case natively and through Via, then requires the client state traces to be identical.

skip.description: Why this case is disabled. Presence disables it; specValidate reports every skipped case so they cannot be forgotten.
